sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/361 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place, search/grid and search/details for facility 504 Malabar Campground; all 15 units on 2027-06-15, samples on 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-31)

values.note: $23 a night without electric (June 2027); off-peak $19 (November 2026, January 2027). Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio prices read 2026-10-31.

hookups.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/malabar-farm-state-park-campground ('15 primitive sites (no electric, no water)'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Fifteen sites with equestrian high-line posts, open to all campers; ReserveOhio types them all equestrian. Posted pads run 43-60 ft (one posts none), partly paved.

sites.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/malabar-farm-state-park-campground ('15 primitive sites') + ReserveOhio site 001 ('This site is equipped with equestrian high line posts but is available to all campers', IsRVSite true) and Pad Length on all 15 units, read 2026-10-31

values.note: Up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/malabar-farm-state-park ('Reservations are required') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/malabar-farm-state-park-campground ('up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727') + ReserveOhio site 001 (MaxStay 14, CheckInStarts 15:00, CheckOutTime 13:00), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Latrines; drinking water within 100 yards of each site.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/malabar-farm-state-park-campground ('Fire rings, picnic tables, drinking water, and latrines are offered') + ReserveOhio (Distance to Drinking Water < 100 Yards), read 2026-10-31

summary: $23 confirmed; 15 primitive sites, no hookups, latrines, drinking water; equestrian-typed but open to all per ReserveOhio; pin 1.1 km off; season left alone.
flags: INCLUSION (horse rule): ReserveOhio and ODNR both call this an equestrian camp ('The park's campsites are outfitted for equestrian camping'; '15 sites designated for equestrian camping'), but ReserveOhio's site 001 says 'available to all campers' and IsRVSite is true (only #001 was read for that wording). Pads of 43-60 ft fit 23 ft. Keep-or-drop on the horse-camp character is a human call; no electric, no dump stated.
PIN: stored 40.6483,-82.3906 is on farm ground ~1.1 km from the sites. Corrected to the site centroid 40.6425,-82.4014 (the cul-de-sac on imagery).
SEASON left unset: ODNR silent. ReserveOhio had all 15 sites open 11/10/2026 and blocked on 1/12 and 3/16/2027, which isn't a statement.
PHONE missing: ODNR campground page gives (419) 892-2784.
